title: Diablo III: Eternal Collection is on our watch list
body: Diablo III: Eternal Collection is one of the games we are looking at for OpenPak. Its online co-op relies on its publisher's own online service, and we are still checking what it needs from a console. We have not yet set a date or promised online play for it, and news will follow here once there is something to try.
footer: OpenPak Diablo III — under study, not promised.
